No chance to stop him, so let's just do what we came to do.|An [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] pilot to [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]]|<ref name="Star Wars: TIE Fighter">[[Star Wars: TIE Fighter (video game)|''Star Wars: TIE Fighter'']]</ref>}}
The '''''Cimigo''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] owned and operated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

==History==
In the year [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the ''Cimigo'' was stationed on the Rebel Outpost ''[[DS 5]]'' in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. It was present on the platform during the defection of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]] to the Rebel Alliance, whose [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] the [[Victory-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Victory-class Star Destroyer]] [[Protector (Victory I-class)|''Protector'']] rendezvoused with Harkov's Rebel contacts on the [[Space station/Legends|platform]].

Just as the initial Imperial reconnaissance mission led by [[Tan (title)|Tan]] [[Maarek Stele/Legends|Maarek Stele]] tracked Harkov to the station, ''Cimigo'' departed the platform and fled the scene at top speed. The Imperial [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] immediately realized the futility of attempting to intercept the [[Transport/Legends|transport]] as it was beyond striking range, so they chose to ignore it in order to focus on sabotaging Harkov's resupply lines. Thus, the ''Cimigo'' safely fled into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
